subject: Slot triage: micro-demo fit + traffic matrix
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@shopforward.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Interested in Redwood - short demo request

Hi Ben,

I signed up and poked around the self-serve sandbox. We are evaluating inference for our search and personalization stack at ShopForward. Would love a short run-through to see fit and ask a few stack questions.

Rough answers here: use case = product search ranking + recommendations; average monthly queries ~4M; peak concurrency unknown; goal is POC in 6 weeks; compliance: SOC 2 required, data residency US.

Can you send a few times this week for a 20 minute micro-demo? Also, is there a template for traffic and volume to share?

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Hayes
Head of Platform
ShopForward
oliver.hayes@shopforward.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@shopforward.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood - short demo request

Thanks Oliver — great to hear you kicked the sandbox.

Quick asks so we make the 20 minutes useful:
- Primary workload: search ranking and recommendations (both) - are you planning generation for rerank only or also candidate generation
- Typical request size: average tokens per request and top-k size
- Expected peak qps and desired P50/P95 latency targets
- Do you need embeddings at serving time or offline only
- Timeline flexibility: you said 6 weeks for POC; is that hard or flexible

I attached a traffic matrix template I can use to map your numbers.

I can do a 20-minute micro-demo or 45-minute deep dive. Proposed 20-minute slots (all PT):
- Wed 11:00-11:20
- Wed 15:00-15:20
- Thu 09:30-09:50

If none work, tell me 2 windows that do and I will match the team.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attach: traffic_matrix_template.csv
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@shopforward.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood - short demo request

Thanks Ben — answers below inline.

- Primary workload: mostly rerank, a little candidate gen for surfacing long-tail items
- Avg tokens per request: 120 tokens
- Top-k size: 10
- Estimated monthly queries: 4.1M (we expect 20% growth next quarter)
- Peak QPS: roughly 35 sustained with spikes to 80
- Embeddings: offline for similarity, not at serving time
- Timeline: we want POC ready in 6 weeks but can be flexible by 1 week
- Compliance: SOC 2 and need US data residency, yes

Can we move slots to next week instead? This week is packed with trade shows. Prefer Tue/Wed next week mornings PT.

Oliver
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@shopforward.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood - short demo request

Great, thanks for the details and the flexibility.

Suggested 20-minute micro-demo slots (PT):
- Tue 10:30-10:50 PT (Wed 17:30-17:50 IST) - covers EU/APAC overlap if needed
- Wed 09:00-09:20 PT
- Wed 11:30-11:50 PT

Agenda (20 minutes):
- 0-3 min: intros and goal check
- 3-12 min: micro-demo focused on rerank path and latency/cost profile
- 12-18 min: quick Q&A on security, compliance and deployment modes
- 18-20 min: next steps (POC runway and resources)

Karthik - can you join the Wed 11:30 PT slot as SE for a short technical Q&A?

I will send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot. Attached is the traffic matrix template and a one-pager on our SLA. Also linking the HubSpot record and Zoom id below.

Thanks,
Ben
